title: Cookie Decorating & Story Time with Mrs. Claus
seo_title: Cookie Decorating & Story Time with Mrs. Claus in Ozark
description: A holiday afternoon at The Workshop where you can decorate cookies from a $7 kit (three holiday-shaped cookies, decorating supplies, and a sprinkles and toppings bar) and hear a story from Mrs. Claus. She arrives at 4 PM, with story time and holiday activities from 4 to 4:45 PM and a group photo at 4:45 PM; the full menu, hot cocoa, coffee, and pastries are available to buy. It is a kids and holiday event on Saturday, December 19, 2026, from 3 to 5 PM at 840 Finley Farms Ln in Ozark, Missouri, and admission is free.
